item.title: ‘I can’t forgive him’: Families of victims react to Hedingham mass shooter’s life sentence
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) — Austin Thompson will spend the rest of his life in prison after shooting and killing five people and injuring two others when he was 15 years old in 2022. item.title: Norfolk police investigate shooting on West 41st Street
item.description: A man was found suffering from a life-threatening gunshot wound in the 800 Block of West 41st Street in Norfolk, and is currently being investigated by the Norfolk Police.

item.title: Large brush fire burns 100 acres in Moyock
item.description: The Moyock Volunteer Fire Department is responding to multiple grass fires at two separate locations, with a multi-agency response including support from multiple fire departments and the North Carolina Forest Service.

item.title: 'Like I've been reborn': Norfolk man acquitted in deadly 2025 shooting
item.description: NORFOLK, Va. (WAVY) -- “Reborn." That’s how Shaiqui McKesson said he felt as he walked out of the Norfolk City Jail after a jury found him not guilty for a deadly shooting that took place last summer. item.title: Gates County traffic stop leads to felony drug charges for woman
item.description: Kellie Marie Howard was arrested and faces multiple felony drug charges after deputies and troopers discovered marijuana, paraphernalia, a vape containing THC resin, and loose prescription narcotics during a traffic stop in Gates County, N.C.

item.title: Battle of Pretty Lake: Norfolk man buys property, claims he is not allowed to use it
item.description: What happens when you buy land, and then you can’t use it? One Norfolk man said it is happening to him, and he has been stuck in a legal battle with the city for the past four years.

item.title: Former FBI profiler and Virginia forensics professor analyzes Nancy Guthrie kidnapping suspect
item.description: WAVY interviewed Retired FBI profiler Mary Ellen O'Toole Friday to get her analysis of what we know so far about the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, mother of Today Show host Savannah Guthrie.

item.title: Man dead after shooting on Lincoln Street in Hampton
item.description: A man is dead after a shooting on Lincoln Street in Hampton Saturday morning, according to the Hampton Police Division.

item.title: Chesapeake Fire Department contains Cedar Road blaze
item.description: The Chesapeake Fire Department responded to a structure fire in the 1700 block of Cedar Road, which was declared under control in 18 minutes with no injuries reported and the primary residence unaffected.
